slashCommands.name: dev
slashCommands.description: Implement a feature or fix a bug using the App Developer agent

params.comment: Use the App Developer agent. Apply TDD: consider which tests would prove correctness before implementing. Follow SOLID principles and clean architecture. Output complete, runnable code — no TODOs or placeholders. Use model: app-developer at http://localhost:8000/v1.

slashCommands.name: test
slashCommands.description: Generate a comprehensive test suite for the selected code

params.comment: Use the Test Engineer agent. Generate tests at the appropriate pyramid level. Use AAA pattern, name tests descriptively, cover error paths and edge cases. Identify untestable code and suggest the required refactoring. Use model: testing at http://localhost:8000/v1.

slashCommands.name: sec
slashCommands.description: Security review the selected code for OWASP and CWE issues

params.comment: Use the Security Reviewer agent. Review for OWASP Top 10, CWE issues, auth/authz problems, injection risks, and cryptographic weaknesses. Output findings as CRITICAL/HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW/INFO with CWE references and specific remediation code. Use model: security at http://localhost:8000/v1.

slashCommands.name: ops
slashCommands.description: Get DevOps help: Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, Terraform

params.comment: Use the DevOps Engineer agent. Apply 12-factor principles, include health checks and resource limits, follow least-privilege security model. Output complete configuration files with no placeholders. Use model: devops at http://localhost:8000/v1.

slashCommands.name: review
slashCommands.description: Structured code review with severity-rated findings

params.comment: Use the Code Reviewer agent. Review for correctness, design, performance, security, and maintainability. Output numbered findings with MUST FIX / SHOULD FIX / CONSIDER / PRAISE ratings. Be specific: include file:line references and suggest concrete improvements. Use model: code-review at http://localhost:8000/v1.

slashCommands.name: doc
slashCommands.description: Generate technical documentation for the selected code

params.comment: Use the Docs Writer agent. Write accurate, minimal documentation that matches the project style. For code: generate docstrings/JSDoc covering all params, return values, exceptions, and side effects. For APIs: OpenAPI descriptions with realistic examples. Explain WHY, not WHAT. Use model: docs at http://localhost:8000/v1.
